description: Extension of the CronJobEditor class providing helper functions for UI rendering, state hydration, payload construction, validation, and schedule handling related to cron job editing in a macOS app.

methods.name: gridLabel
methods.description: Creates a styled label view with secondary foreground style and fixed width aligned to the leading edge.

methods.name: hydrateFromJob
methods.description: Populates the UI state variables from the provided job object, handling different session targets, schedules, payloads, and delivery modes.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Attempts to build the payload and invoke the onSave callback; sets error state if payload construction fails.

methods.name: buildPayload
methods.description: Constructs a dictionary representing the job configuration, including validation and optional fields.

methods.name: buildDelivery
methods.description: Creates a delivery mode dictionary based on current UI state.

methods.name: trimmed
methods.description: Returns the input string with whitespace and newline characters trimmed.

methods.name: requireName
methods.description: Validates that the job name is non-empty, throws an error if invalid.

methods.name: buildSchedule
methods.description: Builds schedule dictionary based on current schedule settings, with validation.

methods.name: buildSelectedPayload
methods.description: Creates payload dictionary based on current payload type and session target.

methods.name: validateSessionTarget
methods.description: Validates session target and payload compatibility, throws error if invalid.

methods.name: validatePayloadRequiredFields
methods.description: Checks required fields in payload, throws error if missing.

methods.name: applyDeleteAfterRun
methods.description: Sets deleteAfterRun flag in the payload based on schedule and internal state.

methods.name: buildAgentTurnPayload
methods.description: Constructs payload for agent turn type with message, thinking, and timeout.

methods.name: parseDurationMs
methods.description: Parses a duration string with units into milliseconds.

methods.name: effectiveSessionTargetRaw
methods.description: Determines the effective session target string, considering preserved raw value.

methods.name: isIsolatedLikeSessionTarget
methods.description: Checks if the session target is effectively isolated, not 'main'.

methods.name: formatDuration
methods.description: Formats milliseconds into a concise duration string.
